t: A short verse about turning things over
a: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ ۖ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَأَنَّهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
p: Yā ayyuha-lladhīna āmanu-stajībū lillāhi wa li-r-rasūli idhā daʿākum limā yuḥyīkum, wa-ʿlamū anna-llāha yaḥūlu bayna-l-mar'i wa qalbih…
m: O you who have believed, respond to Allāh and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. And know that Allāh intervenes between a man and his heart and that to Him you will be gathered.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
